mentions.name: toge
mentions.description: A navigation app for planning road trips with friends. It handles the whole trip from meeting up at the start point through multi-day trips, and automatically plans gas stops where needed. Currently iOS-only, with Android support planned but not a priority. Built with Swift/SwiftUI (written with Claude's help) and a TypeScript backend.
mentions.problem: Coordinating group road trips is hard, from meeting up at a start point to managing multi-day trips and fuel stops.
mentions.audience: Solves a personal problem of coordinating road trips with friends; the author acknowledges it's a niche use case.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I am working on a navigation app to handle road trips with friends.

https://toge.app

The idea is to handle the whole thing, from meeting up at the start point, to multi-day trips, gas stops automagically planned in where you need them.
